digest.component_or_area: CI workflows and Git repository transfers
propositions: CI checkout and fetch commands currently download full blob history for tickets, consuming 1–6.7 GB and 14–400 seconds per run; applying blob:none filter reduces transfer to 22–83 MB and 3.6–14.3 seconds

Production guard blocks must parse git count-objects -v pack size immediately after materialization and fail if it exceeds declared limits: 102400 KiB for standalone verify-identity and 131072 KiB for Gerrit verify-identity

Named-remote filter inheritance and direct-URL --filter=blob:none flags must be verified via Git protocol packet traces confirming server capability advertisement and client filter blob:none request, with assertion that historical large blobs remain missing
Materialization of blobless repositories must not introduce new promisor objects; verify-identity scanning must leave git count-objects -v output unchanged before and after execution

Integration tests must execute real git daemon with filter support, commit incompressible 140+ MiB blobs, remove them, and validate that unfiltered all-history packs exceed thresholds while blobless packs remain below them
